modules.name: rv32i5
modules.description: Top level: pure structural instantiation of the five stages, hazard unit and forwarding unit; drives the fixed external memory/debug/halt interface.
modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; output logic [31:0] imem_addr; input logic [31:0] imem_rdata; output logic dmem_valid; output logic dmem_we; output logic [31:0] dmem_addr; output logic [31:0] dmem_wdata; output logic [3:0] dmem_be; input logic [31:0] dmem_rdata; input logic [4:0] dbg_reg_addr; output logic [31:0] dbg_reg_data; output logic halted; output logic [31:0] exit_code

modules.name: if_stage
modules.description: IF stage and IF/ID pipeline register: holds PC, drives imem_addr, latches imem_rdata plus pc/pc+4 into the IF/ID register; honours stall (freeze), flush (clear valid) and redirect (PC <- target).
modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; input logic stall; input logic flush; input logic redirect; input logic [31:0] redirect_target; input logic [31:0] imem_rdata; output logic [31:0] imem_addr; output logic if_valid; output logic [31:0] if_pc; output logic [31:0] if_pc4; output logic [31:0] if_instr

modules.name: id_stage
modules.description: ID stage, architectural register file (with WB write-first bypass and x0 hardwired to 0), decoder/immediate generation/control generation, ECALL detection, and the ID/EX pipeline register.
modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; input logic flush; input logic if_valid; input logic [31:0] if_pc; input logic [31:0] if_pc4; input logic [31:0] if_instr; input logic wb_we; input logic [4:0] wb_rd; input logic [31:0] wb_data; input logic [4:0] dbg_reg_addr; output logic [31:0] dbg_reg_data; output logic [31:0] x10_data; output logic id_valid; output logic [4:0] id_rs1; output logic [4:0] id_rs2; output logic id_uses_rs1; output logic id_uses_rs2; output logic id_ecall; output logic id_ex_valid; output logic [31:0] id_ex_pc; output logic [31:0] id_ex_pc4; output logic [31:0] id_ex_instr; output logic [31:0] id_ex_rs1_data; output logic [31:0] id_ex_rs2_data; output logic [4:0] id_ex_rs1; output logic [4:0] id_ex_rs2; output logic [4:0] id_ex_rd; output logic [31:0] id_ex_imm; output logic [3:0] id_ex_alu_op; output logic [1:0] id_ex_alu_a_sel; output logic id_ex_alu_b_sel; output logic id_ex_reg_write; output logic id_ex_mem_read; output logic id_ex_mem_write; output logic [2:0] id

modules.name: ex_stage
modules.description: EX stage: operand forwarding muxes, ALU, branch/jump resolution and redirect generation, store-data preparation, and the EX/MEM pipeline register holding the EX/MEM forwarding value.
modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; input logic [1:0] fwd_a_sel; input logic [1:0] fwd_b_sel; input logic [31:0] wb_data; input logic id_ex_valid; input logic [31:0] id_ex_pc; input logic [31:0] id_ex_pc4; input logic [31:0] id_ex_instr; input logic [31:0] id_ex_rs1_data; input logic [31:0] id_ex_rs2_data; input logic [4:0] id_ex_rs1; input logic [4:0] id_ex_rs2; input logic [4:0] id_ex_rd; input logic [31:0] id_ex_imm; input logic [3:0] id_ex_alu_op; input logic [1:0] id_ex_alu_a_sel; input logic id_ex_alu_b_sel; input logic id_ex_reg_write; input logic id_ex_mem_read; input logic id_ex_mem_write; input logic [2:0] id_ex_mem_size; input logic [1:0] id_ex_wb_sel; input logic [3:0] id_ex_branch; input logic [1:0] id_ex_jump; input logic id_ex_is_ecall; output logic ex_mem_valid; output logic [31:0] ex_mem_pc4; output logic [4:0] ex_mem_rd; output logic [31:0] ex_mem_alu_result; output logic [31:0] ex_mem_rs2_data; output logic [4:0] ex_mem_rs2; output logic ex_mem_reg_write; output logi

modules.name: mem_stage
modules.description: MEM stage: data memory request generation with byte enables and lane-replicated write data, MEM-stage store-data forwarding, load byte/half select and sign/zero extension, and the MEM/WB pipeline register.
modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; input logic halted; input logic [31:0] dmem_rdata; input logic wb_we; input logic [4:0] wb_rd; input logic [31:0] wb_data; input logic ex_mem_valid; input logic [31:0] ex_mem_pc4; input logic [4:0] ex_mem_rd; input logic [31:0] ex_mem_alu_result; input logic [31:0] ex_mem_rs2_data; input logic [4:0] ex_mem_rs2; input logic ex_mem_reg_write; input logic ex_mem_mem_read; input logic ex_mem_mem_write; input logic [2:0] ex_mem_mem_size; input logic [1:0] ex_mem_wb_sel; input logic ex_mem_is_ecall; output logic dmem_valid; output logic dmem_we; output logic [31:0] dmem_addr; output logic [31:0] dmem_wdata; output logic [3:0] dmem_be; output logic mem_wb_valid; output logic mem_wb_reg_write; output logic [4:0] mem_wb_rd; output logic [1:0] mem_wb_wb_sel; output logic [31:0] mem_wb_alu_result; output logic [31:0] mem_wb_pc4; output logic [31:0] mem_wb_load_data; output logic mem_wb_is_ecall

modules.name: wb_stage
modules.description: WB stage: final writeback data selection, qualified register write enable (rd!=0, not halted), and the halted/exit_code registers driven by ECALL commit.
modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; input logic [31:0] x10_data; input logic mem_wb_valid; input logic mem_wb_reg_write; input logic [4:0] mem_wb_rd; input logic [1:0] mem_wb_wb_sel; input logic [31:0] mem_wb_alu_result; input logic [31:0] mem_wb_pc4; input logic [31:0] mem_wb_load_data; input logic mem_wb_is_ecall; output logic wb_we; output logic [4:0] wb_rd; output logic [31:0] wb_data; output logic halted; output logic [31:0] exit_code

modules.name: hazard_unit
modules.description: Hazard control: load-use stall detection, redirect/ECALL flush generation, and the halt-pending state that freezes PC and invalidates IF/ID while the ECALL drains to WB.
modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; input logic id_valid; input logic id_ecall; input logic id_uses_rs1; input logic id_uses_rs2; input logic [4:0] id_rs1; input logic [4:0] id_rs2; input logic ex_valid; input logic ex_mem_read; input logic [4:0] ex_rd; input logic redirect; input logic halted; output logic stall; output logic flush_if_id; output logic flush_id_ex; output logic halt_pending

modules.name: forwarding_unit
modules.description: Pure combinational EX-stage forwarding select generator with EX/MEM priority over MEM/WB, excluding x0 and excluding EX/MEM load results.
modules.interfaces: input logic ex_mem_valid; input logic ex_mem_reg_write; input logic ex_mem_mem_read; input logic [4:0] ex_mem_rd; input logic wb_we; input logic [4:0] wb_rd; input logic [4:0] id_ex_rs1; input logic [4:0] id_ex_rs2; output logic [1:0] fwd_a_sel; output logic [1:0] fwd_b_sel

notes: Encodings shared by id_stage/ex_stage/mem_stage/wb_stage (use identical localparams in every file): id_ex_alu_op[3:0] 0=ADD,1=SUB,2=SLL,3=SLT,4=SLTU,5=XOR,6=SRL,7=SRA,8=OR,9=AND. id_ex_alu_a_sel[1:0] 0=rs1,1=pc,2=zero. id_ex_alu_b_sel 0=rs2,1=imm. id_ex_wb_sel[1:0] 0=alu_result,1=load_data,2=pc4. id_ex_branch[3:0] 0=none,1=BEQ,2=BNE,3=BLT,4=BGE,5=BLTU,6=BGEU. id_ex_jump[1:0] 0=none,1=JAL,2=JALR. fwd/sel 0=ID/EX reg value,1=ex_mem_alu_result,2=wb_data. id_ex_mem_size[2:0] carries instr[14:12]. LUI = alu_a_sel=zero/alu_b_sel=imm/ADD; AUIPC = alu_a_sel=pc/imm/ADD; JAL = a_sel=pc/imm/ADD and wb_sel=pc4; JALR = a_sel=rs1/imm/ADD, wb_sel=pc4; branch = a_sel=pc/imm/ADD. id_uses_rs1/rs2 must be 0 for LUI/AUIPC/JAL/ECALL and rs2=0 for loads/JALR. Top wiring: if.imem_addr/imem_rdata to external; hazard.stall->if.stall; hazard.flush_if_id->if.flush; ex.redirect->if.redirect and hazard.redirect; ex.redirect_target->if.redirect_target; if.if_*->id.if_*; hazard.flush_id_ex->id.flush; wb.wb_we/wb_rd/wb_data->id.wb_*, ex.wb_data, mem.wb_*; id.id_ex_*->ex.id_ex_*; id.id_rs1/id_rs2/id_valid/id_ecall/id_uses_*->hazard; id.id_ex_rs1/id_ex_rs2->forwarding; ex.ex_mem_*->mem and forwarding(ex_mem_valid/reg_write/mem_read/rd) and hazard(ex_valid/ex_mem_read/ex_rd); forwarding.fwd_a_sel/fwd_b_sel->ex; mem.dmem_*->external; wb.halted->mem.halted and hazard.halted; id.x10_data->wb.x10_data; wb.wb_we->forwarding.wb_we and wb.wb_rd->forwarding.wb_rd; mem.mem_wb_*->wb. Reset is synchronous low-active everywhere (rst_n used inside always_ff posedge clk); dmem_valid is combinationally masked by rst_n and halted in mem_stage.
